OwnerInfo.Tagline: Software engineer with 2+ years building enterprise ERP/WMS systems using .NET (C#), SQL Server, and JavaScript. Hands-on with event-driven architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native tooling.

ProfessionalExperience.Description: Built an Inventory Reservation System from scratch — covering lifecycle management, allocation workflows, aging analysis, and reporting — rolled out to 150+ enterprise clients within 2 months. Automated state transitions via SQL Server jobs and .NET background services, eliminating 2–3 hours of daily manual reconciliation per client. Developed a semantic-tagging PoC using text embeddings that improved search relevance by ~60% in internal testing.

Owned and enhanced critical WMS modules in a 6+ year legacy C# codebase across inventory, purchasing, and fulfillment. Delivered 150+ feature tickets full-stack with minimal documentation. Reduced API calls on a critical workflow from ~50,000 to under 50, cutting response time from ~9s to under 300ms. Rewrote SQL Server execution plans improving high-traffic query performance by 40–70%.

ContentList.Name: Microblog Platform
ContentList.Description: Full-stack microblog on ASP.NET Core / .NET 10 with JWT auth (access + refresh), secure cookies, and role-based access. Redis caching cut API response time by ~65% under load. NBomber load tests at 500 concurrent users confirmed 1,200+ req/s. Integrated Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Azure Blob/Key Vault, and AI-powered recommendations via vector embeddings.

ContentList.Name: Stocksense — Warehouse Intelligence
ContentList.Description: Inventory intelligence platform for an FMCG distributor managing 1,200+ SKUs across 300+ stores. Built on Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL with pgvector semantic search and a RAG pipeline achieving sub-500ms query response. Aging and low-stock alert engine flags at-risk inventory 3–5 days earlier than prior manual review.

ContentList.Name: Credis (Mini Redis)
ContentList.Description: Redis-like in-memory key-value store over raw TCP sockets in C#. Implements RESP protocol parsing with Span/Memory to avoid heap allocations, uses ArrayPool to reduce GC pressure, and handles concurrent client connections via async I/O.
